scenarios.name: 24/7/365 Service
scenarios.basic_rules: App never goes down. Tech updates happen silently without kicking you off.
scenarios.system_rules: Server checks pass in under a second. Backup systems sync constantly.
scenarios.business_rules: You get real-time status updates. Upgrades get announced days in advance.
scenarios.exceptions: System crashes? Instant automatic reroute. Unresolved alerts ping on-call tech lead.

scenarios.name: Playing Little League
scenarios.basic_rules: League charter exists. Players must meet age/boundary limits.
scenarios.system_rules: Every player participates at least two innings. Pitch count limits instituted by age group. Required equipment must bear official certification stamps.
scenarios.business_rules: Parent signs waiver, coach submits batting order to umpire, teams play 6 innings, post-game high-five line.
scenarios.exceptions: Play is suspended in cases of weather. Ejections handled by umpires.

scenarios.name: Making Change
scenarios.basic_rules: Swap must balance to zero. You can't give money you don't physically have.
scenarios.system_rules: Must be real, not fake or damaged, U.S. currency. Total returned bills/coins equal exact amount owed.
scenarios.business_rules: Friend hands you a $20 for a $5 spot. You check your wallet, pull out a $10 and five $1s, trade cash.
scenarios.exceptions: Only have a $5 bill left? Ask a third friend to break a $10, or settle the difference on Venmo.

scenarios.name: Filing a Car Accident Claim
scenarios.basic_rules: Must have active policy. Personal details and photos locked behind secure encryption.
scenarios.system_rules: Form needs policy number, time, location, and story. Photos under 15MB limit.
scenarios.business_rules: Submit crash details on app. Get claim number. Case assigned to claims adjuster.
scenarios.exceptions: Signed up yesterday and crashed today? System flags potential fraud for human review.

scenarios.name: Receiving a Work Email
scenarios.basic_rules: Must be an active employee with a real work address. Sender identity verified.
scenarios.system_rules: Message loads fast. Attachments scanned for viruses before landing in inbox.
scenarios.business_rules: Email clears security, hits inbox, updates unread count, sends phone notification.
scenarios.exceptions: Suspicious link detected? Email quarantined. Full mailbox bounces incoming mail to sender.

scenarios.name: Baking a Pie
scenarios.basic_rules: Internal temp must reach safe levels (165°F). Oven safety locks prevent kitchen fires.
scenarios.system_rules: Crust-to-filling ratio measured right. Timer set in positive minutes.
scenarios.business_rules: Prep crust, mix filling, assemble, preheat oven, bake, let cool before slicing.
scenarios.exceptions: Crust burning early? Shield edges with foil. Oven turns off? Alert baker instantly.
